# std/new

> Allocate a struct (or any value) on the heap: new Type

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/new.pkg) · translated by [bintables/new](../bintables/new.md)

```
let p = new Point     // ptr Point, every field zero
p.x = 3
```

The memory is zeroed and never freed: Packenger has no garbage collector
yet, which suits short-lived programs such as compilers.

## Syntax

Kind: `expr`

```
new {t: type} -> ptr {t}
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `t` |  | — |
